description: ASINH(x) - inverse hyperbolic sine, ln(x + sqrt(x*x + 1)): zero at 0, the known value at 1, an exact round trip through SINH, and NULL in / NULL out. Converted 1:1 from functions/AsinhTest (now retired); the Java class compared with a 1e-9 tolerance, which the testkit's 10-significant-figure normalisation supplies.
